condition: On React Native iOS with Hermes, dayjs.tz() and dayjs().tz() compute wrong offsets for IANA zones because Hermes's Intl/toLocaleString ignores timeZone. The parsed result can even change as the device clock ticks.
workaround: Load the @formatjs/intl-datetimeformat polyfill (force) on iOS and override tz to derive the offset via formatToParts. Or parse with an explicit numeric offset, e.g. dayjs('...+09:00').
